description: Get one idea from Somebody Build This: the poster's own words, then a builder brief (a suggested weekend plan written by the site's AI steward, not by the person who posted the idea), a prompt for an AI coding tool, and how to ship. Pass the idea's slug (the last part of its URL, like "42-scale-reader") or its ticket number (like 42 or "#0042"). Ideas never lock; when it works, ship it by pressing "Ship it" on the idea page and pasting the link.

slug.description: The idea's slug ("42-scale-reader") or ticket number (42 or "#0042").
